status_note: Reproduces on Snowflake 10.40.102 (https://docs.snowflake.com/en/sql-reference/functions/dateadd gives no range for the amount). Not searched in Snowflake's community forum yet.
summary: `DATEADD(DAY, n, d)` wraps the day count at 32 bits: `DATEADD(DAY, 2147483647, '2024-01-01')` is `-5877587-06-21`, a date in the past, with no error. Smaller amounts compute dates far past year 9999 (`DATEADD(DAY, 10000000, …)` is year 29403).
handling: sverify's SQL range-checks computed dates against the years the reference represents, so both the wrapped and the far result raise.
found_by: the Snowflake characterization: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake, probes date-range-overflow, date-range-far
